rows.what_the_ink_shows: The crop shows de, then the baseline article la, and extension on that same baseline. A separate cursive multi-stroke prefix ending in a hyphen lies above extension; a curved insertion guide rises from immediately before extension toward that prefix. The above-line word is not the two-letter la. The combined corrected wording is la sous-extension, in agreement with Hua’s lexical reading. Inspected crops/145_scan012_H0168.jpg, which contains the baseline article, prefix, and guide together.
rows.note: H0168.R1: Accept Hua’s corrected wording la sous-extension, but the physical placement in the supplied scan assigns the insertion to sous-, while la is on the baseline. The main reader reviewed this crop and confirms the above-line prefix and baseline article; no surrounding text is altered.
